scope: Public storefront design observations; seller claims are not independently verified.

claims.claim: Beauty/cosmetics homepage with multi-slide hero; Whats Hot, Best sellers and Sale product tabs; three-item bundle with Add All To Cart; press testimonials; category/story modules; ingredient/brand-value content; featured product rows, reviews, FAQ and newsletter.

Skincare collection reports 23 products; facets for availability (21 in stock, 2 out), price, size and product type; A–Z sort shown. Grid cards were not visible in the accessibility snapshot; controls untouched.
Protective Day Oil PDP shows $99, 50ml selector, displayed stock 994, quantity/Add/Buy controls, ingredient and information accordions, testimonials. No actions.
Dedicated cart route is empty; suggested accessory, makeup, skincare and cheek collections.
